description: One tab in an ArenaTabs strip, and the panel it shows. ArenaTab draws the button; its content fills the tabpanel ArenaTabs renders beside the tablist.

value.description: What this tab selects, and what the `change` event of ArenaTabs carries.

label.description: What the tab reads. Arena draws the button; the consumer names it.

content.description: What the panel shows while this tab is selected. ArenaTabs places it; ArenaTab never renders it, because a tabpanel may not sit inside a tablist.
